outcome: Surgical site infection (SSI) after cesarean delivery
cohort: 155 patients with SSI and 465 controls who underwent cesarean delivery in a rural area in China
finding: Irregular ANC visits, cesarean delivery after labor, positive discharge culture, higher postoperative CRP levels, and longer work experience of providers were positively associated with SSI, while maternal request for cesarean delivery and postoperative fever were negatively associated with SSI.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery after labor was positively associated with SSI, while maternal request for cesarean delivery was negatively associated with SSI.
